concerns.text: The plan schedules 5 stochastic runs for both the baseline and each perturbed configuration (total ≥10 full training runs) plus additional training for the main model, all within a single 6‑hour wall‑clock limit on a free‑tier GitHub Actions runner (2 CPU cores, 7 GB RAM). Empirically, training a 3‑layer GCN on ≥10 k QM9 molecules on CPU typically exceeds several hours per run; combined with ablation and attribution steps this will likely breach the 6 h budget. Split the pipeline into separate jobs or reduce the number of runs to stay within the compute constraints.

Integrated Gradients are computed for every test molecule. Even with a modest test set (~10 k molecules), IG on CPU can be computationally intensive and may cause the total runtime to exceed the 6‑hour limit. Consider limiting IG to a representative subset or parallelizing across multiple jobs.
